notes: Two branches (Wahb through Khalid; Amr through Hushaym) converge on إسماعيل: the Isma'il, Qays and Abu Bakr levels form the shared tail (rule 3)

The two wordings (Khalid's «إن الناس إذا رأوا الظالم» and Hushaym's «ما من قوم يعمل فيهم») are the two branches' own versions, both stored in the shared chain; wording differences are not separate sayings
«رواه كما قال خالد أبو أسامة وجماعة» and «وقال شعبة فيه» name other transmitters for the same saying: variant groups with their names only, since their own chains are not written
Abu Bakr is the last link: his speech is the saying (rule 6)
